method: All seven final PNG files opened and visually inspected. Native axial sections retain the existing SNL23 scale and unchanged source pixels.

views.observations: Upright cup, inclined nipple/elbow and cover hardware visible in actual native placements. Overall casting form and fitting station remain inferred; no historical placement claim.
Quarter removal exposes opposed bearings, spacer/shims and shaft. The additional input-shaft pin leg is retained. Display crop alone separates portions of the cover; native material is not cut.

Section visibly connects hollow cup reservoir through its stem, elbow and nipple into the drilled housing/spacer. Cup capacity/form and port position are assumptions; this does not establish lubricant delivery rate or sealing.

Both eye and outward tail geometry of the fitted split pin are visible around the castle slots. Long stud projection follows the selected source-length/thread-seat interpretation. Nut diameter is a documented source correction.
Two complete straight legs and two splayed ends are now visible, joined by a semicircular eye. Round-wire proxy and sharp lead transitions remain approximations to formed stock.
Two full parallel legs visibly retained. Eye construction is simplified; ends remain unspread and final retention is pending.

Unchanged cup-OD registration retains prior bearing-width, cast-profile and pinion-size differences. Top/bottom cover fasteners lie near the illustrated joint. Section cannot establish all four stud axes or locate the off-plane grease feed.

disposition: Accept this partial nominal installation with explicit source/placement/shape conflicts; not complete transmission or historical-fit qualification.
required_followup: M265 bush/M266 cap joints, case fastening and controls.
Complete lubricant routing, input pin retention and standard-tank integration.
Retain M249, MX25 and source scale/profile conflicts.
